sn56.102:1.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn56.102:1.2: “taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ,
sn56.102:1.3: yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavī”ti.
sn56.102:1.6: appamattakoyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
sn56.102:1.7: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti, mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito”ti.
sn56.102:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussā cutā manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye manussā cutā niraye paccājāyanti.
